label: Positively fixed root absences, from reasons in natures and carriage (inference)
rule: An admitted reason requires an excluding ESSENCE_6 condition; carriage with member grounding's necessity direction puts it at every admissible extension
meaning: Fix an actual root r at w and a determination d it lacks whose lack fact has an admitted reason (EXPLAINED_ABSENCE_1). The reason-essence thesis gives an ESSENCE_6 condition on r's profile failing at every profile containing r's determinations and d. Every admissible profile containing r's determinations is exclusion-free (necessity direction of member grounding), so carriage puts the condition there (positiveEssenceFromCarriage). Hence no admissible profile adds d to r's determinations: the absence is positively fixed by its first disjunct (EXPLAINED_ABSENCE_2). This is clause 7 of InquiryScopeMap registered as an argument. It gives the sense bridge a derivation that does not run through E; its load is carriage and the necessity direction, as on lane E's route. The main theorem uses no axioms. The Comparator companion factorizationControls (three Mathlib axioms) gives a positive witness and rows where the reason-essence thesis or carriage fails with the bridge failing; on this carrier no row drops the necessity direction alone (see its docstring).
